notes.page_summary: The page explains that p double-prime is literally an inclusion but morally remains a fibration with particularly well-behaved fibres (the adjective itself remains polies/jolies). It proposes a direct algebraic construction of the last diagram after construction of the étale tubular neighbourhood. It then describes constructible sheaf/complex/higher-field data for the present case through ordinary homotopy types or pro-types: a triangular source maps to X_1 and X_0; local coefficients or locally constant n-champs on X_0 and X_1 are linked by a pullback compatibility morphism. The last sentence proposes an exercise that the author says he has not yet carried out and stops at de.

susceptible d'une construction directe, purement algébrique … lorsque l'on a développé la construction du voisinage tubulaire étale
notes.proof_status: No proof of the geometric construction, the reconstructive equivalence, or a statement about fibrations was attempted. Only the local domain/codomain consistency of the drawn span and displayed-in-prose pullback morphism was actually checked.

Two main prose paragraphs are separated by the indented Le point; the second paragraph contains the diagram and continues below it.
notes.math_triggered_reading_decisions: Contravariance of the two displayed maps makes both pullbacks objects over the triangular source, so the arrow is well typed. This check does not decide J/j, Delta/triangle, or the unusual opening mark before F_1; those readings remain governed by ink. The source triangle’s right-side retracing is too high and merged to justify an extra subscript.
notes.nontext_marks: Three dark detached short marks are reproduced neutrally and inventoried with uncertain hand/origin. Their presence is visually distinguishable from surrounding faint grain; no meaning is inferred. Tiny-mark enlargement does not add original information.
